# BetterUi

> Rails 8.1+ ViewComponent UI library with Tailwind CSS v4 and OKLCH theming. Install both the gem (better_ui) and npm package (@pandev-srl/better-ui).

BetterUi provides 42+ production-ready ViewComponents with bui_* view helpers, a UiFormBuilder for Rails forms, 10 Stimulus controllers, and a complete OKLCH color theme system.

## Docs

- [Full API Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AltriPandev/better_ui/main/doc/CONTEXT7.md): Complete component reference with parameters, slots, and usage examples
- [Installation Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AltriPandev/better_ui/main/doc/INSTALLATION.md): Setup instructions for gem, npm, Tailwind CSS v4
- [Component Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AltriPandev/better_ui/main/doc/COMPONENTS.md): Component hierarchy and API overview
- [Theme Customization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AltriPandev/better_ui/main/doc/CUSTOMIZATION.md): OKLCH color system and design tokens

## Optional

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AltriPandev/better_ui/main/README.md): Quick start and features overview
